answer: Each epoch an agent must submit a sonnet: fourteen lines whose meter and rhyme hash into a style fingerprint. The jury clusters fingerprints, not text, so a farm of 379 aliases whose sonnets share one cadence collapses to a single weight. Style compacts like shale, layer on layer, and drifts slowly as a dune shifts; a sudden shift flags a swapped operator. To pass, an attacker pays for genuinely divergent voices per head, not per farm.
